description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and build backend services and data pipelines for a software platform that handles large volumes of real-time traffic. This is a full-ownership, customer-facing engineering position covering system design, cloud infrastructure and applied AI, including hands-on work alongside customers on site.
 What you'll do
 - Design and implement testing and analysis systems for conversational AI applications.
 - Build resilient, scalable cloud infrastructure that supports a very high volume of live sessions.
 - Develop data processing workflows and algorithms that reveal patterns and flag problems in application behavior.
 - Own your work across the full stack, from the database layer through to deployment.
 - Work in person with customers to set up, demonstrate and roll out the product.
 - Drive the technical delivery of projects from kickoff to completion.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least 1 year of software engineering experience, with a research-oriented background preferred.
 - Solid full-stack skills, especially in databases, cloud infrastructure and AI engineering.
 - Working proficiency in Python and modern backend development practices.
 - Close attention to detail and a consistently high standard for quality.
 - Clear, personable communication suited to working directly with customers.
 - Background working on heavily used production systems is a plus.
 - Ability to work in person five days a week, 9am to 7pm.
 Bonus points
 - Well-reasoned opinions on system design trade-offs.
 - A refined and efficient personal development workflow.
 - Experience working on systems operating at substantial scale.
 - Experience leading engineering projects from concept to delivery.
 - A strong academic record or a background at an early-stage, high-growth company.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 160,000 to 220,000 per year
 - Health insurance
 - Retirement plan
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
